(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    chicken15 cassava15 plantain15 pickle15 radish15 beans15 bun_bot bun_top - item
  )

  (:predicates 
    (raw ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (mashed ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
    (cutting_board_free)
    (fryer_free)
    (boiler_free)
    (done_grill_chicken15)
    (done_mash_cassava15)
    (done_boil_beans15)
    (lag_stack_chicken15)
    (lag_stack_bun_top))
  (:durative-action grill_chicken15
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (raw chicken15)) (at start (grill_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw chicken15))) (at start (not (grill_free)))
                 (at end (grilled chicken15)) (at end (stackable chicken15)) (at end (grill_free))
                 (at end (done_grill_chicken15))))
  (:durative-action boil_cassava15
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw cassava15)) (at start (boiler_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw cassava15))) (at start (not (boiler_free)))
                 (at end (boiled cassava15)) (at end (boiler_free))))
  (:durative-action mash_cassava15
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (boiled cassava15)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (boiled cassava15))) (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
                 (at end (mashed cassava15)) (at end (cutting_board_free))
                 (at end (done_mash_cassava15))))
  (:durative-action cut_plantain15
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw plantain15)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw plantain15))) (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
                 (at end (cut plantain15)) (at end (cutting_board_free))))
  (:durative-action fry_plantain15
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (cut plantain15)) (at start (fryer_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (cut plantain15))) (at start (not (fryer_free)))
                 (at end (fried plantain15)) (at end (fryer_free))))
  (:durative-action cut_pickle15
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw pickle15)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw pickle15))) (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
                 (at end (cut pickle15)) (at end (cutting_board_free))))
  (:durative-action cut_radish15
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw radish15)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw radish15))) (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
                 (at end (cut radish15)) (at end (cutting_board_free))))
  (:durative-action boil_beans15
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw beans15)) (at start (boiler_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw beans15))) (at start (not (boiler_free)))
                 (at end (boiled beans15)) (at end (boiler_free))
                 (at end (done_boil_beans15))))
  (:durative-action stack_bun_bot

  (:durative-action stack_chicken15

- **fry** `<item>`  —  Fry an item in a fryer. Takes 8 seconds. Produces a fried item. NOTE: some items must be cut before they can be fried (see ingredients).

(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    feast_plate patty20 salmon20 chicken20 tofu20 fish20 falafel20 potato20 onion20 yam20 turnip20 stock20 beans20 lettuce20 tomato20 cucumber20 carrot20 online_fry_20_11 online_grill_20_12 - item
  )

  (:predicates 
    (raw ?i - item) (grilled ?i - item) (cut ?i - item) (marinated ?i - item) 
    (fried ?i - item) (boiled ?i - item) (mashed ?i - item) 
    (stackable ?i - item) (stacked ?i - item) (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free) (cutting_board_free) (fryer_free) (boiler_free) (marinator_free))
  (:durative-action cut
    :parameters (?i - item) :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw ?i))) (at start (not (cutting_board_free))) 
                 (at end (cut ?i)) (at end (stackable ?i)) (at end (cutting_board_free))))
  (:durative-action marinate
    :parameters (?i - item) :duration (= ?duration 6)
    :condition (and (at start (cut ?i)) (at start (marinator_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (cut ?i))) (at start (not (marinator_free))) 
                 (at end (marinated ?i)) (at end (stackable ?i)) (at end (marinator_free))))
  (:durative-action boil
    :parameters (?i - item) :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (boiler_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw ?i))) (at start (not (boiler_free))) 
                 (at end (boiled ?i)) (at end (stackable ?i)) (at end (boiler_free))))
  (:durative-action mash
